newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds to retrace down to 100.25.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds to retrace down to 100.25.

text.p: June Bund futures on LIFFE face a retracement of their recent gains, technical analysts said on Tuesday.
"The market has already declined from 101.14 to today's low of 100.37," said Raynard Cheng, technical analyst at First Chicago in London.
"Below it, 100.25 is the next retracement level."
June Bund futures were trading at 100.49 at 0652 GMT, three basis points above Monday's settlement price.
Norman Beauchamp, head of derivatives at Cooperative Bank in London, said Bunds would be underpinned on the downside.
"It's held in despite the fact (U.S. Treasury) bonds have been off overnight," he said.
Beauchamp said Bunds were generally oversold under most time horizons.
"Probably for the short term that will hold the market in and it will just move sideways," he said, pegging a range of 100.35 to 100.60.
"Medium term we're still in this bear market. It's easier to knock the market lower than higher," he added.
Traders also said they expected a slight recovery today but that rallies should be regarded as good opportunites to sell ahead of a move lower.
However if the market can maintain 100.38,34, there will be scope for a move back higher with 100.55, then 100.62 attracting prices.
Carol Harmer, a trader and technical analyst on LIFFE, said a break of 100.34 would negate any immediate upside and leave the contract poised to trade lower to support between 100.05 and 100.02.
